[RTCT.3.3] **`contract:` field requirements** (compile-time
enforced):

  - All scalar fields listed in [RTCT.3.2] under `contract:`
    MUST be present and ≥ 1 (zero is rejected as
    `DS_ERR_CONTRACT_INVALID`; the engine has no zero-sized
    legitimate state).
  - There MUST be exactly one entry in `contract.nodes:` for
    each alpha, beta, and terminal node in the loaded rule
    network; `node_id` values MUST match the compiler-assigned
    IDs; missing entry or unknown node_id is
    `DS_VALIDATE_COMPILE_CONTRACT_INCOMPLETE`.
  - There MUST be exactly one entry in `contract.series:` for
    each series backend in the rule set.
  - `kind` MUST be one of `alpha`, `beta`, `term`.
  - All capacity fields are uint32; values exceeding 2^31-1
    are rejected (`DS_ERR_CONTRACT_INVALID`).

These requirements are **compile-time** only (the source-level
`.dsrt` contract); the per-node coverage rule above is *not* a
runtime check and MUST NOT be cited for load-time rejection
(see [RTCT.6.7.6]). The `.dsrt` **source** schema is unchanged
by the compact encoding: an author still writes one
`contract.nodes:` entry per node. The compiler MAY compact the
*compiled* `RealtimeContract` atom per [RTCT.6.7]; this is invisible
at the source level and changes neither the logical contract
nor its hash.
